Application Process for Degree and Non-Degree Seeking Students
Inbound Students
a.  Foreign degree seeking students are advised to get student visa (9F) right after receipt of acceptance letter from the Office of Admission, and before enrollment. b.  Please visit Philippines Embassy in your home country to inquire student visa fee, and duration of student visa application. c.  or those foreign students who were able to enroll in Mapua University with temporary visitor visa, please report to the Office of International Linkages, Relations, and Development Cooperation within 3 days after arrival in the Philippines. You are advised to report in person and bring all requirements for your student visa application. d.  Lead time for application of non-degree seeking students is 6 months. e.  Lead time for degree seeking students is 12 months.
Outbound
a.  Lead time for application processing including internal approval and visa application is 3 months.
